headline: API-access prospect: price was the blocker; email follow-up and Monday call agreed

suggested_routes.label: Deal / partner next step
suggested_routes.rationale: A returning prospect with a known price concern agreed to an email and a Monday/Tuesday call.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C03 — "Send the email and we can speak Monday or Tuesday."
suggested_routes.output: Next step (owner: Kiran, stated on the call): send the email titled "Developer access and event notifications — follow-up". Restate the earlier offer to work to the prospect's budget, then call Monday or Tuesday. Expect low urgency: the prospect said the functionality "isn't essential enough for us to spend much on it."
suggested_routes.owner: Kiran (stated: "I can email you... I'll also try you on Monday")

evidence.quote: We discussed developer access a while ago, and you asked for about five weeks before following up.
evidence.supports: This is a timed follow-up on an earlier conversation.

evidence.quote: We did ask about some developer functionality, but it isn't essential enough for us to spend much on it.
evidence.supports: Interest exists but is low priority and price-sensitive.

evidence.quote: When we last spoke, price was a concern.

evidence.supports: Agreed email subject the prospect will look for.

evidence.quote: Send the email and we can speak Monday or Tuesday.
evidence.supports: Prospect agreed to the next step.

concise_output: Kiran followed up with Milan on API/developer access after a requested five-week gap. The prospect remembers the evaluation, says it is not essential enough to spend much on, and agreed to an email plus a Monday/Tuesday call. Poor audio limited the conversation.
what_established: Earlier evaluation of developer access; price was a concern; Milan agreed to receive an email and speak Monday or Tuesday; Kiran said he would email and call.
what_not_established: Budget, decision process, or whether the team still wants the capability ("perhaps we are still interested"). No deal value.
next_action: Kiran sends the agreed email today and calls Monday/Tuesday; ask for a budget range as previously offered.
uncertainty: Audio problems on both sides; the prospect's recollection is uncertain ("I can't quite remember").
label_check: Stored observed_outcome 'follow_up' agrees with the text.
